mapper.select: SELECT b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status IN ('승인', '대기') THEN e.amount END), 0) AS remain FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.budget_id = b.budget_id WHERE b.budget_id = #{budgetId} GROUP BY b.amount FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense (budget_id, emp_id, title, amount, req_date) VALUES (#{budgetId}, #{empId}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{reqDate})
INSERT INTO approval_history (expense_id, actor_id, action) VALUES (#{expenseId}, #{actorId}, #{action})
